connector.name: MCP Jira Stdio
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Jira Cloud - issues, search, comments, attachments, transitions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-jira-stdio. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the freema account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JIRA_EMAIL
env.description: Email of the Jira account the API token belongs to

env.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Jira API token (id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens)

env.name: MCP_REDACT_SENSITIVE
env.description: Set to true to redact sensitive values from logs

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error (default: info)
